wish_topics.evidence_span: close the gap between knowing and feeling
what a person understands about someone else's suffering registers with something like its true weight
Most of the harm I see in human history doesn't come from people who want to hurt others. It comes from distance
enormous suffering persists alongside enough resources and goodwill to end much of it
your sense of what matters isn't distorted by what's near, vivid, or familiar
for people to be harder to fool about what's real
empathy can be manipulated, tribal, and selective. So maybe what I really want is for people to be harder to fool about what's real, including about each other
